profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer focused on Software Architecture, Infrastructure and Cloud Systems
profile.geoLocationName: Port St Lucie, Florida, United States
profile.summary:
At EHS Technologies, my role as a Software Engineer with SECRET clearance has been marked by a commitment to developing intuitive web tool interfaces and streamlining site-wide applications.

In mentoring new hires and refining back-end server interactions, I've contributed to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. With a focus on user interface code bases, I have empowered our team to deliver quality software solutions that align with our core mission of reliability and speed.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Architecture · Configuration Management · Software Infrastructure · DevOps · Ansible · Gitlab · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Windows Server · Active Directory · Internet Information Services (IIS) · System Administration · Operating Systems · Domain Name System (DNS) · System Deployment · Virtualization · Leadership · User Administration

positions.title: Software Engineer (SECRET Clearance)
positions.description:
* Responsible for development of internal, site wide, web tool user interface using the ReactJS (React JavaScript) web development tooling suite.
        * Provided custom react components that allowed rapid development of site wide administration tools and training applications.
        * Helped mentor and give advice on back-end server RESTful (REpresentational State Transfer) API formatting.
        * Mentored new hires on the User Interface code base allowing the new hires to get up to speed in development quickly and efficiently.
        * Profiled the internal training site code to provide a speed profile on what needs to be refactored for speed and reliably
        * Presented internal training site demos for the customer
        * Code reviewed internal training site merge requests for the team to ensure code quality and completeness
        * Helped write technical documentation for common issues found when bringing on a new computer asset
        * Used third-party NodeJs (Node JavaScript) libraries to help develop modular, reusable user interface components for the internal training site
        * Manual data migration for training data from the old wiki pages to new training site
        * Bi-monthly release testing
        * Modernization of older internal php web tools
        * Write and maintain PHP, python, shell scripts and javascript in legacy web applications
        * Wrote user authentication and permission system to improve security and access control
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · PHP · React.js · Full-Stack Development · HTML · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Git · Programming · NoSQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer (SECRET Clearance)
positions.description:
* Responsible for refactoring, maintaining and fixing multiple, high availability, co-dependent libraries and applications.
* Mentor new hires on the code base, company policies and testing procedures.
* Worked on complex high-risk/visibility issues that affect product deliverability timelines.
* Refactor C/C++ code to be more efficient at runtime.
* Support product regression tests.
* Support +8 hour product stress tests.
* Refactored build-system to use CMake lowering compile times from 24 hours to 3 hours.
* Wrote new server/client applications to support the frontend java GUIs (Graphical User Interface).
* Wrote new startup/shutdown supporting application to aid in system stability.
* Wrote new backend messaging interfaces to communicate with external products.
* Help support the customer with understanding and using the product.
* Take customer feedback on how they want the product to be designed to work.
* Maintain the latest version of our eclipse IDE to support our product.
* Educate and support department developers on the eclipse IDE
